name: Acortalink
description: Membuka link tujuan ketika tombol halaman sudah menyediakan alamatnya.
script: function resolve(input) { for(var i=0;i<input.links.length;i++){ var link=input.links[i]; if(link.selector==='a.button#contador' && link.href && link.href!=='#') return {url:link.href}; } return null; }

attribution.note: Ready-link selector adaptation only. Does not copy upstream AdGuard message spoofing, popup overrides or challenge automation.
